summary_1line: Karna boasts he will defeat Arjuna in battle, while Kripa warns that confronting the famed warrior is reckless and ill-timed.

image_candidates.scene_text: Karna stands on his chariot with bow drawn, declaring that his golden-winged arrows will swarm the sky like fireflies around Arjuna.
Kripa rebukes Karna before the gathered Kaurava warriors, recounting Arjuna’s legendary feats while soldiers listen anxiously.
Karna imagines Arjuna pierced with countless golden arrows, appearing like a mountain covered in bright Karnikara flowers.
